description: Book a HomeMaster service for the customer: only the one they asked for, never an extra. Ask for their name, their phone number and their OK first, and never fill a field with a guess or a placeholder. The answer's `outcome` says what was booked. (1) whatsapp_card, home cleaning: we sent the customer Helen's booking card on WhatsApp, showing the date, their address, the clean and their price; nothing is booked until they tap "Yes, book it" within 60 minutes, then they pay by the payment link Helen sends, and the time is not held while they decide. Needs postal_code, unit, date, a start_time from find_times, and hours. Returns a reference for booking_status. (2) call_back_booked, a service under more_services: HomeMaster needs to find out more before it can price and schedule the job, so what you book is a call back, free of charge. Tell the customer that, ask when they are free for a call, and send a 2-hour window (call_back_date and call_back_from). Our team calls them in that window with the price and a time for the job. No message is sent and nothing is paid. Returns a reference (hmc_) for booking_status. To move the call, call this again with a new window. For a customer with several such jobs, book each service in the same window: our team makes one call. (3) pick_a_call_back_time: you called for such a service without a window; nothing is saved, and the answer holds the question to ask and the windows we take. Aircon servicing is not booked here: use start_booking.

agent_name.description: Optional, cleaning: your name as the customer knows you (letters, digits and spaces), shown on the card as "<name> asked us to book this for you".

call_back_date.description: A service under more_services: the day the customer is free for our call, YYYY-MM-DD, Singapore date, today to 14 days ahead.

call_back_from.description: A service under more_services: the start of the 2-hour window for our call, HH:MM in Singapore time, on the hour or half hour, 09:00 to 19:00 (so the latest window is 7pm to 9pm).

customer_name.description: The customer's name. Required for a service under more_services. For cleaning: recommended, saved only once they confirm, and never over a name we already have.

details.description: A service under more_services: the job in the customer's words, with what the price depends on (see its service card): what, how many, what size, what is wrong. Never make a detail up.

frequency.description: Cleaning only: one-time, weekly, or bi-weekly (every 2 weeks).

hours.description: Cleaning only: visit length in hours (see find_services for the lengths we sell, e.g. 2, 3 or 4).

phone.description: The customer's number, e.g. +6591234567. For cleaning it must be on WhatsApp.

service.description: cleaning, or the code of a service under more_services from find_services, e.g. pipe_leak_repair.

start_time.description: Cleaning: HH:MM in Singapore time, one of the start times from find_times.

unit.description: Cleaning: floor and unit number, e.g. #05-12. Ask the customer; never make one up.

name: request_booking
title: Book for the customer
